question: Tell me the most purchased other products and their quantities by customers who bought the Google Red Speckled Tee each month for the three months starting from November 2020.
sql:
-- Verify: show top 5 items per month
WITH red_speckled_txn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ecommerce.transaction_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`, UNNEST(items) AS items
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase' AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND items.item_name = 'Google Red Speckled Tee'
    AND ecommerce.transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND ecommerce.transaction_id != '(not set)'
),
purchase_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date, ecommerce.transaction_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND ecommerce.transaction_id IN (SELECT transaction_id FROM red_speckled_txn)
),
item_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.event_date,
    p.transaction_id,
    items.item_name,
    SUM(items.quantity) AS total_qty
  FROM purchase_events p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e
    ON p.event_date = e.event_date AND p.transaction_id = e.ecommerce.transaction_id
  , UNNEST(e.items) AS items
  WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase'
    AND items.item_name != 'Google Red Speckled Tee'
  GROUP BY p.event_date, p.transaction_id, items.item_name
)
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date), MONTH) AS purchase_month,
  item_name,
  SUM(total_qty) AS total_quantity
FROM item_counts
GROUP BY purchase_month, item_name
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY purchase_month ORDER BY SUM(total_qty) DESC) = 1
ORDER BY purchase_month
